claim: Four measures over 31 complete project weeks: work commits, models and checks, recovered dispatches, and documented Epic completions. Early shading denotes missing records, not zero activity. Counts do not measure productivity.
alt: Four measures over 31 complete project weeks: work commits, models and checks, recovered dispatches, and documented Epic completions. Early shading denotes missing records, not zero activity. Counts do not measure productivity.
caption: *Development activity and engineering structure over 31 weeks.* (a) Reconstructed landed work commits; (b) declared models, consumers of multiple models, and registered static and dynamic verifier files; (c) recovered dispatches; (d) documented Epic completions. Shaded intervals lack retained records and do not establish zero activity. Activity and inventory counts describe the factory’s growth, not the value or correctness of its output. [short: Development activity and engineering structure]
